en.title: Jon Kasdan Conjures Supernatural YA Rom-Com 'Sid & Zoey' for Netflix
en.summary: Creator Jon Kasdan is bringing a darkly romantic supernatural YA series, 'Sid & Zoey,' to Netflix. The eight-episode series promises a blend of forbidden attraction and paranormal peril.
en.body:
Get ready for a fresh dose of supernatural teen drama. **Jon Kasdan**, known for his work on **Disney+'s *Willow*** and co-writing **Solo: A Star Wars Story**, is set to deliver **_Sid & Zoey_**, a brand-new eight-episode YA rom-com series for Netflix.

The premise alone is enough to pique our interest: a sophisticated, amoral New York teen named Sid is sent to live with his mother's estranged family in a seemingly idyllic Mississippi town. There, he encounters Zoey, the chief's sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter. Despite their immediate, palpable attraction, the two find themselves drawn into a hidden, darker world lurking beneath the town's quaint exterior.

> "Over eight episodes, the series will follow Sid, a seductive, sophisticated, and amoral teenager from New York, as he’s sent to live with a police chief and his family in the idyllic Mississippi town where his mother grew up. Among them is the chief’s sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter, Zoey. Resisting their mutual attraction, Sid and Zoey find themselves drawn into a dark, hidden world beneath the town’s picture-postcard facade — and a paranormal puzzle that may well get them killed (if they don’t kill each other first)."

This isn't just a simple forbidden romance; it's a story steeped in mystery and the paranormal, promising scares alongside the sparks. Kasdan, who also penned episodes of **_Dawson's Creek_** and **_Freaks and Geeks_**, is no stranger to the YA landscape or tales with an otherworldly bent. His collaboration with **John Shiban**, a seasoned writer and showrunner known for his work on **_Ozark_**, **_Supernatural_**, and **_Breaking Bad_**, further solidifies the series' potential for gripping storytelling.

## A Supernatural Blend for a Dedicated Fandom

The involvement of **J.J. Abrams' Bad Robot** and **Blumhouse Atomic Monster** signals a significant production backing for **_Sid & Zoey_**. This combination of creative talent and production powerhouses suggests a high-quality series that aims to captivate the dedicated YA audience. Fans of shows that expertly weave romance, mystery, and supernatural elements will likely find themselves deeply invested in Sid and Zoey's journey. The 'fish-out-of-water' narrative, coupled with the inherent danger of their paranormal entanglement, sets the stage for a compelling, high-stakes drama that could become a must-watch for genre enthusiasts.

## What to Expect as the Veil Lifts

While a precise release date for **_Sid & Zoey_** has not yet been announced, Netflix's straight-to-series order indicates that production is likely well underway or planned for the near future, with a 2026 debut being a strong possibility. We'll be keeping a close eye on casting announcements and further plot details as they emerge from this exciting new supernatural rom-com.

Really, you just have two names—but you also have Sid & Zoey , a new show coming to Netflix from creator Jon Kasdan. According to Netflix : Over eight episodes, the series will follow Sid, a seductive, sophisticated, and amoral teenager from New York, as he’s sent to live with a police chief and his family in the idyllic Mississippi town where his mother grew up. Among them is the chief’s sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter, Zoey. Resisting their mutual attraction, Sid and Zoey find themselves drawn into a dark, hidden world beneath the town’s picture-postcard facade — and a paranormal puzzle that may well get them killed (if they don’t kill each other first). It’s a fish-out-of-water tale focused on an unlikely pair with plenty of scares. The show has been ordered straight to series, which means its arrival is nigh inevitable. It’s created by Kasdan, who is possibly best known for co-writing Solo with his father, Lawrence Kasdan (who more famously co-wrote The Empire Strikes Back ). The young Kasdan also wrote several episodes of Dawson’s Creek and a movie called In the Land of Women , and created the short-lived Willow series. Jon Kasdan will write, showrun, and executive produce Sid & Zoey with John Shiban, an experienced TV producer and writer who has worked on shows ranging from The Vampire Diaries to Dune: Prophecy to Ozark to Torchwood . There are also quite a few recognizable names among the additional executive producers: J.J. Abrams and Rachel Rusch Rich for Bad Robot and Jason Blum, James Wan, and Rob Hackett for Blumhouse Atomic Monster. No casting or production timeline has been announced for Sid & Zoey.
